entities.name: Former Cistercian Abbey in Oliwa
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Oliwa Abbey was the Cistercian monastic community in Oliwa, the oldest monastic establishment in Gdańsk Pomerania, which existed continuously from 1188 to 1831, now a Historic Monument of Poland.
